test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = '{codec}') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} SELECT number, concat(if(cityHash64(number) % 1000 != 0, 'near ', ''), 'thread k', toString(number % 64)) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['thread', 'k17'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['thread', 'k17']) SETTINGS query_plan_optimize_count_from_text_index = 0
SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['near', 'k17']) SETTINGS query_plan_optimize_count_from_text_index = 0
SELECT sum(id) FROM text_index_dense_blocks_{codec} WHERE hasToken(s, 'near')
